selection.rule: requirement fallback row whose frontmatter is a description envelope whose config subtree carries only the F0 leaves plus the admitted look (P1), theme (P2) and top-level title (P3)
selection.phase_partition: renderer-free classification with pinned per-phase denominators; only ENABLED_PHASES is emitted
selection.classification_priority: title -> P3, else theme -> P2, else look -> P1
selection.exclusions: layout: elk (24), namespaced config.flowchart.* (2) and malformed envelopes (2) stay whole-source fallback

P3-title.reviewer_agent: agent:c4f1a7e29b3d60851 rfc0037-p3-final-review (independent adversarial code review; r1 REQUEST-CHANGES -> r2 APPROVE; verified the ER-decoder fix and the seven decoder-branch negatives, title+footer and title+D204-direct-style composition, six-file scope with protected-file/manifest immutability, generator --check, 6/6 cohort gate, 10/10 F0 suite, and an official matrix red only on the pending verdict)
P3-title.note: P3 projects the top-level title through the shared relation-title seam. Reviewer disposition: the first draft decoded with the config-leaf helper; the ER decoder (er_yaml_value + Kind::Text) is now used and the seven non-text/malformed scalars are asserted as fallbacks.

P2-theme.reviewer_agent: agent:aa19624ebdb712b6a rfc0037-p2-final-review (independent adversarial code review; APPROVE; verified the 4-file scope and protected-file/manifest immutability, the closed 7-palette table and F0/P1 footer byte-identity, an independent 172/23/91/6 re-derivation with the 7-corpus/84-synthetic split, a ported audit of the synthetic config-free twin, generator --check, cohort gate 4/4, F0 suite 10/10, and an official matrix red only on the pending verdict)
P2-theme.note: P2 admits the closed theme palette table; title rows keep whole source. Reviewer NITs applied: the gate's config-free twin now skips blank lines like the generator, a corpus twin may not be the row itself, and a quoted palette scalar is asserted.

P1-look.reviewer_agent: agent:ab5e96a11461da018 rfc0037-p1-final-review (independent adversarial code review; r1 REQUEST-CHANGES -> r2/r3 APPROVE; verified scope, the closed look table, generator --check, the 23-row corpus-twin gate, F0 footer byte-identity and the official-matrix pending-refusal)
P1-look.note: P1 admits config.look only; theme/title rows keep whole source. Reviewer dispositions: the RFC disclosure example was aligned to the implemented string, unbalanced-quote/empty-config/title negatives were added, the synthetic-twin composition was deferred to P2, and the title negatives were made well-formed up to the single violated rule.
